mexico_quotation.non_substantial: Two separated complete sentences, 82 words in total, identify the symptoms and the mechanism for comparison with the selected original places within a multi-page scholarly essay; no surrounding argument is reproduced and the extracts cannot substitute for the essay.
mexico_quotation.normal_exploitation: The attributed sentences support research and education alongside the German original and the stand’s conceptual reading. They do not replace the essay or the translated volume, or interfere with its normal reading and sale.
mexico_quotation.source_integrity: The printed text and punctuation are preserved, with only line wraps normalized. Author, translator, work, edition, source and printed pages are identified.

Aufsatz p289.text: The distinguishing mental features of melancholia are a profoundly painful dejection, abrogation of interest in the outside world, loss of the capacity to love, inhibition of all activity, and a lowering of the self-regarding feelings to a degree that finds utterance in self-reproaches and self-revilings, and culminates in a delusional expectation of punishment.
Aufsatz p289.alignment: The whole sentence enumerates the same mental symptoms and progression to delusional expectation of punishment as the selected German sentence.

Aufsatz p292.text: So we get the key to the clinical picture—by perceiving that the self-reproaches are reproaches against a loved object which have been shifted on to the patient’s own ego.
Aufsatz p292.alignment: The sentence identifies self-reproaches as reproaches against a loved object shifted onto the ego, matching the selected German sentence.

Aufsatz p289.alignment: Compared the complete German sentence p. 289 with the printed English p. 153 including punctuation. Both enumerate painful mood, loss of interest and capacity to love, inhibition, diminished self-regard, self-reproach and delusional expectation of punishment.

Aufsatz p292.alignment: Compared the complete German sentence p. 292 with printed English p. 158, including the dash and possessive. Both identify self-reproaches as reproaches redirected from a loved object to the patient’s own ego.

mexico_quotation.assessment: For the stated research stand, two nonadjacent complete sentences totaling 82 words serve as attributed evidence for distinct selected points, alongside the German and conceptual commentary, in a much longer published essay. They are not a simulated substantial reproduction and do not substitute for normal exploitation of the essay or volume. Wording and punctuation match the 1925 printed pages, with the author, translator, edition and page identified. This assessment concerns the stated display and depends on its actual context; it does not resolve other jurisdictions.
